senses.gloss:
सुबन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Well-secured, having a good binding.
 m. (-न्धः)
Sesamum.
 E. सु, and बन्ध binding.

सुबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Wise, clever, intelligent.
 E. सु, बुद्धि intellect.

सुबोध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
 1. Easily taught.
 2. Of easy apprehension.
 m.
(-धः)
 1. Knowledge.
 2. Waking.
 E. सु, and बोध making known.

सुब्रह्मण्य m. (-ण्यः)
 1. KĀRTIKEYA.
 2. Name of one of the sixteen priests
employed at a sacrifice.
 E. सु good, and ब्रह्मण्य the Brāhmanical
order, of whom he is the special guardian.
